rules.erasure: Erasure check at the edited state (readout s = entering block s, after the edit): normalised SSDC N_s <= 0.1, and on held-out images exact probe <= 4.0x chance and row and column probes <= 1.5x chance. The reading uses the first of ['mean', 'scale', 'sub'] that passes; none passes = ERASURE INCOMPLETE.
rules.normalisation: N_b = (SSDC_b - floor_b) / (intact_b - floor_b), only where intact_b - floor_b >= 0.1; raw SSDC always reported. Floor = all rotations off (RoPE), embedding zeroed (APE), both (hybrid).
rules.reading: R = N_max - N_s, N_max = max N_b over readouts s+1..11 where N_b is defined. REBUILDS if R >= 0.2 and N_max >= 0.5; DOES NOT REBUILD if R < 0.05; otherwise PARTIAL. Predicted: APE does not rebuild, RoPE rebuilds; a RoPE model that does not rebuild is NpkG's counterexample.
rules.case: Outcome case for the paper (the notebook only labels): case 1 if all four RoPE models rebuild at s=4 and no APE model does; case 2 if one or two RoPE models do not rebuild (PARTIAL counts as not rebuilding); case 3 (stop and discuss) if three or more do not; no case if any RoPE model reads ERASURE INCOMPLETE or NOT READABLE; any APE model that rebuilds is flagged.
